paths.name: @/lib/prisma
paths.message: Prisma connects as the table owner and BYPASSES row-level security, so every policy in supabase/migrations/0001_rls.sql is silently ignored on that connection. One prisma.house.findMany() here serves every client's build to whoever asked. Use createOwnerClient() from @/lib/supabase/server. See lib/supabase/README.md.

paths.name: @prisma/client
paths.message: Owner-facing code must not reach the database as the table owner. Use createOwnerClient() from @/lib/supabase/server, which is subject to row-level security.

patterns.message: Prisma bypasses row-level security. Owner-facing code must use @/lib/supabase/server.
